_note: Stub data for 07-ClassificationByCategoryTests and 08-ClassificationByProductTests. Naming: dt = decision table, ep = equivalence partition, bva = boundary value, eg = error guessing, st = state transition.

summary._note: AbcSummaryCards divides each bucket's onHandQuantity by totalOnHandQuantity. epBalanced is arithmetically consistent on purpose — TC05 asserts the fixture itself reconciles before trusting the shares. bvaSliverBand puts band B at 10/20000 = 0.05%, which rounds to 0% and must therefore render as '<1%'.

categoryRows._note: Category grid rows. The Overrides cell reads 'None' at zero and the count otherwise, with a tooltip saying those products 'will not follow this category' (ByCategoryTab.tsx:78-90). A category always carries a class — it is never null.

productRows._note: One row per rung of the resolution ladder. The arithmetic matters: dtOverridden's effectiveClass equals its abcClassOverride (the override wins over a DIFFERENT categoryClass, so the test can tell them apart), and dtInherited's equals its categoryClass with no override set. dtDefault is the bottom rung — no override, no category class.

bulk._note: BULK_ABC_MAX_PRODUCTS is 1000 (Backend abc-classification.schema.ts:16), so bvaOverCapRowCount is one past it. The result payloads are merged over stubBulk()'s echo of the request, so they only need to state what the toast reads.

errors._note: Server messages the screens must surface unaltered. egClassChangeRefused is sliced to its first 30 characters by TC30, so the opening must be distinctive.
errors.egCategoryLoadFailed: Could not load categories for classification.
errors.egClassChangeRefused: Category class is locked while a live audit counts this class.
